semantic_models.name: triathlon_results
semantic_models.description: Result-grain semantic model for triathlon result counts, split medians, and review-signal rates.

measures.name: result_rows
measures.description: Number of result rows under the current filter context.

measures.name: finishers
measures.description: Number of result rows marked as finishers under the current filter context.

measures.name: valid_sbr_finishers
measures.description: Number of finishers with valid gender and complete swim, bike, and run splits.

measures.name: any_review_rows
measures.description: Number of valid result rows where at least one review-family flag is active.

measures.name: event_context_rows
measures.description: Number of result rows affected by event-leg course-context flags.

measures.name: record_integrity_rows
measures.description: Number of result rows with strict row-level timing or arithmetic integrity issues.

measures.name: individual_profile_rows
measures.description: Number of result rows with unusual swim-bike-run profile spread after course-context handling.

measures.name: model_residual_rows
measures.description: Number of result rows with model residual review flags.

measures.name: individual_hard_flag_rows
measures.description: Number of rows that remain individual hard-flag candidates after likely course-context cases are separated.

measures.name: median_overall_seconds
measures.description: Median overall finish time in seconds.

measures.name: median_swim_seconds
measures.description: Median swim split time in seconds.

measures.name: median_bike_seconds
measures.description: Median bike split time in seconds.

measures.name: median_run_seconds
measures.description: Median run split time in seconds.

dimensions.name: any_review_flag
dimensions.description: Broad review-signal flag. This is not an accusation.

dimensions.name: event_context_flag
dimensions.description: Indicates likely event-level course or recording context.

dimensions.name: record_integrity_flag
dimensions.description: Indicates strict row-level timing or arithmetic integrity review signals.

dimensions.name: individual_profile_flag
dimensions.description: Indicates unusual split-profile review signals after course-context handling.

dimensions.name: individual_hard_flag
dimensions.description: Indicates rows that remain hard-flag candidates after likely course-context cases are separated.
